text:
Sam (Sales): Quick sync — FastBank POC needs an assurance package for procurement. They asked for ISO27001 cert, SOC 2 Type II (redacted), and a signed pen-test letter. Timeline: legal wants everything by next Wed. Can security confirm we can provide these?
Priya (Security): We can provide ISO cert PDF + SOC2 redacted report. Pen-test letter needs Legal sign-off. I'll prep the pen-test-letter-template — need customer full name and engagement ID.
Jordan (Solutions): Also include a short network diagram and data-flow doc for their security team. FastBank asked about on-prem constraints and data retention policies; I'll sketch those.
Claire (Legal): I can sign the pen-test letter but need to review the SOC2 redactions first. Use Claire@redwood.com as the signatory. Priya, please drop the template and suggested attestation text here.
Sam (Sales): Customer contact is mike@fastbank.com and procurement lead is tara@fastbank.com. They also want an estimated monthly cost for the POC in the same packet — is that okay?
Priya (Security): We don't include pricing in assurance docs. We'll keep cost separate. For the pen-test letter we can include: "pen test performed by third party on 2025-10-02" and a high-level scope.
Jordan (Solutions): For POC pricing, I'm recommending a 3-week Dedicated trial + managed support. Sam, you can present a ballpark $4k/week reserved capacity figure in the proposal.
Sam (Sales): Got it — I'll separate pricing conversation. For this thread we need signed letter + certs only.
Claire (Legal): Draft guidance: we sign an attestation that we maintain SOC 2 controls and will provide redacted report. I'll proof the pen-test wording. Mark the signature block for me.
Priya (Security): Uploaded preliminary files to internal bucket: s3://redwood-sec/assurance/fastbank/pen-test-letter-template.docx and SOC2_redacted_draft.pdf. audit-bot: upload event recorded.
audit-bot: Files uploaded -> s3://redwood-sec/assurance/fastbank/ (pen-test-letter-template.docx, SOC2_redacted_draft.pdf, ISO27001_cert.pdf) :lock:
Sam (Sales): Thanks — shared the links with Mike. He just asked if we can also provide a short "permission to test" note (so their vendor can scan during the POC). Is that different from the pen-test letter?
Claire (Legal): Yes — permission-to-test is a customer-facing approval granting scanning during the engagement. Pen-test letter is a summary of results/attestation. We can provide both. Priya, can you add a permission_to_test template?
Priya (Security): Will add permission_to_test_v1.docx and tidy the attestation language.
Jordan (Solutions): Handoff checklist: 1) Claire signature on pen-test + permission doc, 2) upload final signed PDFs to S3, 3) update compliance tracker (ticket #COM-4521), 4) email download links to customer. Sam — confirm when they ack.
Sam (Sales): I will. ETA for final signed package: Tue EOD (internal SLA).
Claire (Legal): I'll review and sign Mon morning.
Priya (Security): Ping me once signed and I'll move files into the customer folder and trigger the audit-bot notification. :thumbsup:
Sam (Sales): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Mike and post any feedback here.
